{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Kinder Morgan North Texas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from interconnect in Lamar County, Texas to FPL Energy Forney power plant, Kaufman County, Texas.

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Kinder Morgan Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/power-grid/fpl-energy-announces-txu-and-kinder-morgan-to-build-gas-pipelines-to-new-power-plant-in-forney-texas/|title=renewableenergyworld.com|website=renewableenergyworld.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''300 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''86 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/power-grid/fpl-energy-announces-txu-and-kinder-morgan-to-build-gas-pipelines-to-new-power-plant-in-forney-texas/|title=renewableenergyworld.com|website=renewableenergyworld.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/power-grid/fpl-energy-announces-txu-and-kinder-morgan-to-build-gas-pipelines-to-new-power-plant-in-forney-texas/|title=renewableenergyworld.com|website=renewableenergyworld.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2002<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.renewableenergyworld.com/power-grid/fpl-energy-announces-txu-and-kinder-morgan-to-build-gas-pipelines-to-new-power-plant-in-forney-texas/|title=renewableenergyworld.com|website=renewableenergyworld.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$70,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
